title: English Conversation 26:  Noisy Neighbor
content: 1. to be sick and tired of doing something: to be bored or annoyed of something that one has been doing for a long time - I am sick and tired of working with her. I really don't like her. - She is sick and tired of dealing with customers. She wants a job that doesn't involve working with customers. 2. the rent: the money one pays every month to live or use a place - The rent is high, but the apartment is in a great location. - Did you pay the rent for this month? 3. a tough choice: a difficult decision A) Should we go to Thailand or Vietnam for our vacation? B) That is a tough choice. A) Do you want to have pizza or steak for dinner? B) That's a tough choice.
